raw_graphql_pull_request.body: Part of #43519 (roadmap item: *Qwen-Image-2.1 — adapt the existing SGLang Diffusion pipeline for Ascend*). ## Motivation Qwen-Image 2.1 already runs on Ascend through `torch_npu`, but two hot paths in the DiT stay on the slow eager implementations: `QwenImage21Attention` forces the native fp32 QK RMSNorm on every platform, and the complex RoPE goes through the complex64 multiply path. This PR routes both to the CANN operators exposed by `torch_npu`: - `torch_npu.npu_rms_norm` for `norm_q` / `norm_k`. - `torch_npu.npu_rotary_mul(..., rotary_mode="interleave")` for the complex RoPE, with the cos/sin tables prepared once per layout and cached. Cos/sin for `npu_rotary_mul` must be expanded with `repeat_interleave(2)`; a plain `cat((c, c), -1)` pairs the wrong frequencies. The previously attempted Triton fast-path enablement on NPU is **not** part of this change: the QK-norm+RoPE Triton kernel is not bit-exact for sequence lengths ≥ 1024 and is 60–95× slower than the eager chain on Ascend. The three kernel files touched by that attempt are restored to their pre-enablement state. The result is full Qwen-Image 2.1 coverage on one A3 chip: text-to-image, single- and multi-reference editing, transparent RGBA output, and local recolor, with NPU CI cases and baselines. ## Modifications - `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/models/dits/qwen_image21.py` - `QwenImage21Attention`: `force_native=not current_platform.is_npu()` for `norm_q` / `norm_k`, so NPU dispatches to `npu_rms_norm` (bit-identical to the native fp32 path in our measurements). - `apply_rope`: NPU branch using `npu_rotary_mul` with cached cos/sin. - `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/server/ascend/testcase_configs_npu.py` - Five `qwen_image21_*` NPU cases with the same sampling contract (1024×1024, png, 40 steps, guidance 1, seed 42, `quality="lossless"`): t2i, single-reference edit, two-reference edit, transparent output, and local recolor. - All five set `run_consistency_check=False` in this commit; the t2i case is switched on together with the NPU GT pin in a follow-up commit once the GT-gen workflow has published its image. - `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/server/ascend/perf_baselines_npu.json` - Baselines for the five new cases. - `scripts/ci/utils/diffusion/prefetch_input_image.py` - Also cache the second multi-image reference and export `SGLANG_TEST_MULTI_IMAGE_INPUT_IMAGE`. - `.github/workflows/diffusion-ci-gt-gen-npu.yml` - Run the input prefetch before `gen_diffusion_ci_outputs`, so the reference edit cases can produce their published images. - `python/sglang/srt/environ.py` - `SGLANG_TEST_MULTI_IMAGE_INPUT_IMAGE`. - `docs/cookbook/diffusion/Qwen-Image/Qwen-Image-2.1.mdx` - Add Ascend to the hardware picker note and the recommended-hardware table (no separate platform section, matching the Qwen-Image cookbook layout). - `docs/src/snippets/configs/Qwen/qwen-image-2.1.jsx` - Add Ascend A3 to the deployment picker: Torch SDPA only, resident placement, `--warmup-mode request`. ## Verification CI cases - All five `qwen_image21_*` cases run end-to-end with `run_consistency_check=False` in this commit, so the PR CI does not depend on a GT that does not exist yet. The recolor case edits the shared TI2I image (orange skirt and bow to deep blue). - Follow-up (same PR, after the GT exists): the `diffusion-ci-gt-gen-npu` workflow runs `qwen_image21_t2i_1npu` on the NPU runner and publishes `qwen_image21_t2i_1npu_1gpu.png` to `diffusion-ci/consistency_gt/sglang_generated/ascend/` in `sgl-project/ci-data-diffusion`. A follow-up commit then enables the t2i consistency check and bumps the NPU `test_utils.py` pin to the returned SHA, in the same commit. **No image is uploaded by hand.** - Both edit inputs are staged by `prefetch_input_image.py` (the shared TI2I image and the second multi-image reference) in `pr-test-npu.yml` and in the GT-generation workflow. `direct_url_test=True` is not used on NPU: it asks the model server to fetch the URLs, while the runner-side prefetch keeps the server offline-capable. - NPU perf baselines for all five cases are in `test/server/ascend/perf_baselines_npu.json`, produced on one A3 chip with `python -m sglang.multimodal_gen.test.scripts.gen_perf_baselines --case ...` (not hand-written); the existing 13 entries are untouched. ### Reproduction ```bash # t2i sglang generate --model-path /path/to/Qwen-Image-2.1 \ --prompt "Doraemon is eating dorayaki" \ --num-inference-steps 40 --guidance-scale 1 \ --height 1024 --width 1024 --seed 42 --num-gpus 1 \ --generator-device cuda --save-output ``` ```bash # ti2i (2D -> 3D) sglang generate --model-path /path/to/Qwen-Image-2.1 \ --image-path TI2I_Qwen_Image_Edit_Input.jpg \ --prompt "Convert 2D style to 3D style" \ --num-inference-steps 40 --guidance-scale 1 \ --height 1536 --width 1024 --seed 42 --num-gpus 1 \ --generator-device cuda --save-output ``` ```bash # multi-image edit (two references; edit2509_1.jpg / edit2509_2.jpg from the # Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 test set) curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1/images/edits \ -F "model=/path/to/Qwen-Image-2.1" \ -F "image=@edit2509_1.jpg" -F "image=@edit2509_2.jpg" \ -F "prompt=The magician bear is on the left, the alchemist bear is on the right, facing each other in the central park square." \ -F "size=1024x1024" -F "num_inference_steps=40" -F "guidance_scale=1" \ -F "seed=42" -F "quality=lossless" -F "response_format=b64_json" ``` ```bash # local recolor (CI case): orange skirt and bow -> deep blue curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1/images/edits \ -F "model=/path/to/Qwen-Image-2.1" \ -F "image=@TI2I_Qwen_Image_Edit_Input.jpg" \ -F "prompt=Change the orange skirt and bow to deep blue, keeping her pose, face, hair, and the SGL logo unchanged." \ -F "size=1024x1024" -F "num_inference_steps=40" -F "guidance_scale=1" \ -F "seed=42" -F "quality=lossless" -F "response_format=b64_json" ``` Transparency is an HTTP generation request with `"background": "transparent"`. The CI recolor case uses `/v1/images/edits` with the shared TI2I image; the transparent-cat recolor below is a separate manual check. ## Accuracy Tests Platform: Ascend A3, CANN 9.1.0, torch 2.10.0+cpu / torch_npu 2.10.0.post6. Same chip, same seed, `--generator-device cuda` (device RNG, matching the HTTP CI path). Metrics are the repository's consistency metrics (RGB, alpha ignored). ### t2i: A+B (`npu_rms_norm` + `npu_rotary_mul`) vs eager, seeds 42–47 | seed | SSIM | PSNR (dB) | CLIP | mean_abs_diff | max_abs | MSE | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 42 | 0.9839 | 30.28 | 0.9983 | 1.716 | 236 | 60.91 | | 43 | 0.9885 | 36.65 | 0.9963 | 1.571 | 139 | 14.05 | | 44 | 0.9881 | 37.43 | 0.9968 | 1.216 | 95 | 11.76 | | 45 | 0.9777 | 30.58 | 0.9947 | 2.225 | 248 | 56.91 | | 46 | 0.9695 | 28.91 | 0.9903 | 3.140 | 223 | 83.55 | | 47 | 0.9711 | 27.18 | 0.9901 | 3.169 | 219 | 124.34 | Repository thresholds: CLIP ≥ 0.92, SSIM ≥ 0.95, PSNR ≥ 28 dB, mean_abs_diff ≤ 8. All six seeds pass CLIP and mean_abs_diff; five of six pass SSIM; seed 47 is 0.82 dB below the PSNR threshold (mean_abs_diff 3.17, well inside). Visual inspection: the subject, shape and colors are preserved; differences are pixel-level. ### ti2i: 2D → 3D style conversion (A+B) Input is the shared CI edit image `TI2I_Qwen_Image_Edit_Input.jpg` (sha256 `0d56a63fca6ef8fe2a0ca27a0774c2bada9b2a198aeedbfdfb23bec09d0d3901`), prompt `Convert 2D style to 3D style`, seed 42, 40 steps, guidance 1. End-to-end on one A3 chip (A+B, `quality="lossless"`): 23.1 s at 1024×1024 (denoise 16.69 s, 0.417 s/step, decode 2.79 s) and 36.8 s at 1536×1024 (denoise 28.25 s, 0.706 s/step, decode 4.74 s). ### multi-image editing (A+B) Two reference images (`edit2509_1.jpg` magician bear, `edit2509_2.jpg` alchemist bear, from the Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 test set), sent as two `image` fields to HTTP `/v1/images/edits`; seed 42, 40 steps, guidance 1, 1024×1024, `quality="lossless"`. The server log confirms the request carries both paths. - **Composition** — with the multi-image CI prompt ("The magician bear is on the left, the alchemist bear is on the right, facing each other in the central park square."), both identities are preserved (hat/robe/book/wand, graduation cap/cauldron/fan/Qwen shirt) and placed as instructed. - **Slot binding** — with "the bear from image 1 … image 2 …", uploading `[ref1, ref2]` puts ref1 on the left and ref2 on the right; uploading `[ref2, ref1]` swaps them. The second file lands in ``; it is not silently dropped or merged into the first. - **Ablation** — one reference at a time produces only that subject. - **Determinism** — repeating the request, or running it on a different chip, reproduces a byte-identical PNG. The CI case uses the two references staged for the NPU runner (the shared TI2I image and `rabbit.jpg`); the bear pair above is the manual slot-binding check. | request | CLIP | SSIM | PSNR (dB) | mean_abs | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | official (2 refs, CI prompt) | 0.9793 | 0.8285 | 17.78 | 10.182 | | order [1,2] | 0.9983 | 0.9631 | 26.58 | 1.972 | | order [2,1] | 0.9913 | 0.8986 | 21.39 | 5.811 | | ref 1 only | 0.9995 | 0.9947 | 39.80 | 0.666 | | ref 2 only | 0.9986 | 0.9768 | 25.97 | 1.992 | Differences vs eager concentrate on anti-aliased outlines and glyphs, with no structural or identity change (the amplified diff maps are edge-only). A two-reference request carries a 2×4096-token condition prefix, so the same tiny operator-level rounding differences are amplified relative to the single-reference case; CLIP stays ≥ 0.979. The edit case has no GT (`run_consistency_check=False`), so these numbers are supplementary evidence, not a consistency gate. ### Local recolor (A+B, CI case) Input is the shared TI2I image; the prompt changes the orange skirt and bow to deep blue, keeping the pose, face, hair, and SGL logo unchanged. ### RGBA / transparency (A+B) Prompt: an isolated cat on a transparent background, with `background="transparent"` and `output_format="png"`. | | alpha min/max | alpha mean | alpha<250 | alpha<128 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | eager | 0 / 255 | 83.62 | 69.13% | 67.20% | | A+B | 0 / 255 | 83.70 | 69.11% | 67.17% | - alpha MAE 0.117, alpha max diff 32, transparent-mask IoU 0.9993 - RGB SSIM 0.9976, PSNR 46.70 dB The model does produce a meaningful alpha channel (~69% transparent pixels); A+B preserves it almost exactly. ### Manual check: transparent cat recolor with alpha (A+B) This is a separate manual check, not the CI recolor case above. Input is the eager transparent cat; the prompt changes the orange fur to gray while preserving the alpha channel. - alpha MAE 0.043, alpha max diff 15, transparent-mask IoU 0.9997 - RGB SSIM 0.9992, PSNR 49.98 dB - fur color (mean RGB / saturation over alpha>128): input `[195.7, 144.3, 89.4]` / 0.56 → eager edit `[140.1, 130.5, 122.2]` / 0.248 → A+B `[139.8, 130.3, 122.1]` / 0.247 ## Speed Tests and Profiling Same chip , seeds 43–47, `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1`, saved-request e2e (`Pixel data`), NPU RNG. | variant | s/step | denoise (s) | decode (s) | e2e (s) | Δ step | Δ e2e | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | eager | 0.3820 | 16.897 | 0.328 | 19.644 | — | — | | + npu_rms_norm | 0.3549 | 16.313 | 0.331 | 19.086 | -7.09% | -2.84% | | + npu_rotary_mul | 0.3745 | 16.697 | 0.327 | 19.438 | -1.95% | -1.05% | | + npu_rms_norm & + npu_rotary_mul | 0.3419 | 16.006 | 0.328 | 18.842 | **-10.50%** | **-4.08%** | The combined variant clears the repository's ≥1.5% mean e2e improvement gate for optimization PRs. Measurements are same-chip, same-seed pairs; a strict A,B,B,A ABBA round is reproducible with the commands above. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :hourglass_flowing_sand: [Run #40475153388](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40475153388) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #40475153424](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40475153424) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #40475153494](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40475153494)

Metrics are the repository's consistency metrics (RGB, alpha ignored). ### t2i: A+B (`npu_rms_norm` + `npu_rotary_mul`) vs eager, seeds 42–47 | seed | SSIM | PSNR (dB) | CLIP | mean_abs_diff | max_abs | MSE | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 42 | 0.9839 | 30.28 | 0.9983 | 1.716 | 236 | 60.91 | | 43 | 0.9885 | 36.65 | 0.9963 | 1.571 | 139 | 14.05 | | 44 | 0.9881 | 37.43 | 0.9968 | 1.216 | 95 | 11.76 | | 45 | 0.9777 | 30.58 | 0.9947 | 2.225 | 248 | 56.91 | | 46 | 0.9695 | 28.91 | 0.9903 | 3.140 | 223 | 83.55 | | 47 | 0.9711 | 27.18 | 0.9901 | 3.169 | 219 | 124.34 | Repository thresholds: CLIP ≥ 0.92, SSIM ≥ 0.95, PSNR ≥ 28 dB, mean_abs_diff ≤ 8. All six seeds pass CLIP and mean_abs_diff; five of six pass SSIM; seed 47 is 0.82 dB below the PSNR threshold (mean_abs_diff 3.17, well inside). Visual inspection: the subject, shape and colors are preserved; differences are pixel-level. ### ti2i: 2D → 3D style conversion (A+B) Input is the shared CI edit image `TI2I_Qwen_Image_Edit_Input.jpg` (sha256 `0d56a63fca6ef8fe2a0ca27a0774c2bada9b2a198aeedbfdfb23bec09d0d3901`), prompt `Convert 2D style to 3D style`, seed 42, 40 steps, guidance 1. End-to-end on one A3 chip (A+B, `quality="lossless"`): 23.1 s at 1024×1024 (denoise 16.69 s, 0.417 s/step, decode 2.79 s) and 36.8 s at 1536×1024 (denoise 28.25 s, 0.706 s/step, decode 4.74 s). ### multi-image editing (A+B) Two reference images (`edit2509_1.jpg` magician bear, `edit2509_2.jpg` alchemist bear, from the Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 test set), sent as two `image` fields to HTTP `/v1/images/edits`; seed 42, 40 steps, guidance 1, 1024×1024, `quality="lossless"`. The server log confirms the request carries both paths. - **Composition** — with the multi-image CI prompt ("The magician bear is on the left, the alchemist bear is on the right, facing each other in the central park square."), both identities are preserved (hat/robe/book/wand, graduation cap/cauldron/fan/Qwen shirt) and placed as instructed. - **Slot binding** — with "the bear from image 1 … image 2 …", uploading `[ref1, ref2]` puts ref1 on the left and ref2 on the right; uploading `[ref2, ref1]` swaps them. The second file lands in ``; it is not silently dropped or merged into the first. - **Ablation** — one reference at a time produces only that subject. - **Determinism** — repeating the request, or running it on a different chip, reproduces a byte-identical PNG. The CI case uses the two references staged for the NPU runner (the shared TI2I image and `rabbit.jpg`); the bear pair above is the manual slot-binding check. | request | CLIP | SSIM | PSNR (dB) | mean_abs | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | official (2 refs, CI prompt) | 0.9793 | 0.8285 | 17.78 | 10.182 | | order [1,2] | 0.9983 | 0.9631 | 26.58 | 1.972 | | order [2,1] | 0.9913 | 0.8986 | 21.39 | 5.811 | | ref 1 only | 0.9995 | 0.9947 | 39.80 | 0.666 | | ref 2 only | 0.9986 | 0.9768 | 25.97 | 1.992 | Differences vs eager concentrate on anti-aliased outlines and glyphs, with no structural or identity change (the amplified diff maps are edge-only). A two-reference request carries a 2×4096-token condition prefix, so the same tiny operator-level rounding differences are amplified relative to the single-reference case; CLIP stays ≥ 0.979. The edit case has no GT (`run_consistency_check=False`), so these numbers are supplementary evidence, not a consistency gate. ### Local recolor (A+B, CI case) Input is the shared TI2I image; the prompt changes the orange skirt and bow to deep blue, keeping the pose, face, hair, and SGL logo unchanged. ### RGBA / transparency (A+B) Prompt: an isolated cat on a transparent background, with `background="transparent"` and `output_format="png"`. | | alpha min/max | alpha mean | alpha<250 | alpha<128 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | eager | 0 / 255 | 83.62 | 69.13% | 67.20% | | A+B | 0 / 255 | 83.70 | 69.11% | 67.17% | - alpha MAE 0.117, alpha max diff 32, transparent-mask IoU 0.9993 - RGB SSIM 0.9976, PSNR 46.70 dB The model does produce a meaningful alpha channel (~69% transparent pixels); A+B preserves it almost exactly. ### Manual check: transparent cat recolor with alpha (A+B) This is a separate manual check, not the CI recolor case above. Input is the eager transparent cat; the prompt changes the orange fur to gray while preserving the alpha channel. - alpha MAE 0.043, alpha max diff 15, transparent-mask IoU 0.9997 - RGB SSIM 0.9992, PSNR 49.98 dB - fur color (mean RGB / saturation over alpha>128): input `[195.7, 144.3, 89.4]` / 0.56 → eager edit `[140.1, 130.5, 122.2]` / 0.248 → A+B `[139.8, 130.3, 122.1]` / 0.247 ## Speed Tests and Profiling Same chip , seeds 43–47, `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1`, saved-request e2e (`Pixel data`), NPU RNG. | variant | s/step | denoise (s) | decode (s) | e2e (s) | Δ step | Δ e2e | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | eager | 0.3820 | 16.897 | 0.328 | 19.644 | — | — | | + npu_rms_norm | 0.3549 | 16.313 | 0.331 | 19.086 | -7.09% | -2.84% | | + npu_rotary_mul | 0.3745 | 16.697 | 0.327 | 19.438 | -1.95% | -1.05% | | + npu_rms_norm & + npu_rotary_mul | 0.3419 | 16.006 | 0.328 | 18.842 | **-10.50%** | **-4.08%** | The combined variant clears the repository's ≥1.5% mean e2e improvement gate for optimization PRs. +def _npu_rope_cos_sin(rope, dtype):
